_comment: Plant <-> fauna relationships for Alberta natives. Each link is resolved at seed time by matching plant common_name and fauna scientific_name. Every record MUST carry a `source` naming a key in data/sources_master.json - src/data_quality.py:validate_plant_fauna fails the build otherwise, and src/db/plants.py:_seed_fauna reports any name that does not resolve rather than dropping the edge silently.
_sources: See data/sources_master.json for the canonical bibliography. This block used to list the works inline and had drifted: it named four, while the file cited six - Packer, Pattie & Fisher and Acorn's Bugs of Alberta appeared on 47 edges and were declared nowhere. A partial duplicate of the bibliography is worse than a pointer to it.
_evidence: These are DOCUMENTED edges: a record somebody read in a work. Derived edges - genus-level host records expanded onto the catalogue - are computed at seed time into plant_fauna_derived by src/db/derived_edges.py and are never hand-edited here.

notes: Sole larval food source for Monarch caterpillars (Asclepias only).
Prairie subspecies dodi is an Artemisia specialist.
Aspens host hundreds of moth/butterfly species; their caterpillars are critical chickadee nestling food.
Spring-flying mining bees are tightly linked to willow catkins.
Critical early-spring pollen for emerging solitary bees.
Mason bees are key spring fruit-tree pollinators.
Leafcutters cut discs from rose foliage to line nest cells.
Rose hips persist into winter for waxwings and grosbeaks.
Blue Jays cache acorns, aiding oak dispersal.
Grouse eat birch catkins and buds in winter.
Flickers excavate cavities in aspen snags later used by many species.
Merlins reuse old corvid nests in spruce.
Dense thorny shrubs shelter low nests.
Groundcover and litter shelter predatory ground beetles.
Dragonfly larvae develop among submerged/emergent sedge stems.
Silver-haired bats roost under loose bark.
Bunchgrass provides voles food and runway cover.
Bumble bees work the orange saucer flowers for pollen.
Small sweat bees at the open umbels.
Late-season nectar for migrating painted ladies.
